want: to add, rename, and remove transaction categories and subcategories from Settings, instead of being limited to a fixed hardcoded list
soThat: the app fits spending categories that were not originally written for one household
acceptance: the app ships with the existing 13 categories pre-seeded as defaults, so existing transactions keep their category unchanged
the Settings screen has a Manage Categories entry listing every category and its subcategories
the user can add a custom category, and add, rename, or delete subcategories under any category
a default (seeded) category cannot be deleted, since the Dashboard and Budget tab category breakdowns are keyed to the original 13 categories
the Add Transaction form's category and subcategory pickers reflect the current list instead of a compiled-in map
the Dashboard and Budget tab category breakdowns are unaffected by this change and continue to total only the original 13 categories, until a separate project generalizes that aggregation
